tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: The insecticidal activity of brachyin.
footnotes: Brachyin was dissolved in insect saline and injected into American cockroaches (Periplaneta americana; mass 700–900 mg) and mealbeetles (Tenebrio molitor larvae; mass 190–210 mg). The death of the insects was counted.
For each dosage of brachyin, a total of 10 insects were tested.
Data are means±SEM of triplicate determinations (n = 10).
